item.title: About Vent Viper
item.description: Vent Viper is owned and operated by Danny Dooner, right here in Wyckoff, NJ. Danny started Vent Viper with a simple idea: homeowners in Bergen County deserve a reliable local pro they can actually talk to — not a franchise call center, not a random contractor from three counties away. When you call Vent Viper, Danny picks up the phone. When he shows up at your door, he’s your neighbor.
